commands.name: pumpFrames
commands.summary: Wait for a number of main-thread queue passes.

arguments.name: count
arguments.description: Clamped to 1..100000; this counts UI queue passes, not elapsed seconds or distinct output evaluations.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Defaults to 1; explicit null or invalid conversion throws.

commands.result: Empty object {} with envelope counters from the completion frame.
commands.effects: Registers a pending reply; does not change playback speed or force a particular operator to evaluate.
commands.completion: Deferred. Count decrements at the beginning of later queue passes. Other requests may finish first; responses must be matched by ID. Timeout/disconnect does not cancel queued work.

commands.name: setTime
commands.summary: Set or report current playback time.

arguments.name: timeInBars
arguments.description: Takes precedence over timeInSecs whenever the property exists, including explicit null. Negative values accepted; no finite/range validation in the handler.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Leave time unchanged unless timeInSecs is supplied.

arguments.name: timeInSecs
arguments.description: Converted through current BPM: bars = seconds * BPM / 240. Ignored when timeInBars exists.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Leave time unchanged unless timeInBars is supplied.

commands.effects: Changes Playback.Current time; does not pause playback. Omission of both fields reads current time. Explicit null/nonconvertible values throw.
commands.completion: Immediate acknowledgement; subsequent frames can advance time when playing.

commands.name: setPlayback
commands.summary: Set or report current playback speed.

arguments.name: speed
arguments.description: Takes precedence over playing whenever present. Negative speeds accepted. Handler does not validate finite values or impose bounds.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Use playing if supplied; otherwise retain current speed.

arguments.name: playing
arguments.description: true sets speed 1; false sets speed 0. Ignored when speed exists.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Leave speed unchanged unless speed supplied.

commands.effects: Changes Playback.Current speed. getContext reports isPlaying as abs(speed) > 0.001. Explicit null for either selected field throws.
commands.completion: Immediate acknowledgement; timeline advancement is later frame work.

commands.name: getAudioInputs
commands.summary: List available input devices and current capture analysis state.
commands.result: Object {devices:[{name:string,isLoopback:boolean}],active:string|null,level:number}. No recording-path or recording-status field is returned.
commands.effects: Enumerates input devices lazily on first request. Does not start capture. Enumeration can be empty if the native engine is unavailable.
commands.completion: Immediate snapshot; level is the decaying input level and active is the current capture device, not proof of a recording.

commands.name: setAudioInput
commands.summary: Choose external input analysis or the project's soundtrack.

arguments.name: device
arguments.description: Nonempty selects ExternalDevice and stores the name without checking that it exists. Empty selects ProjectSoundTrack. No trim or case-insensitive matching.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Missing or null acts as empty string.

commands.effects: Mutates composition playback settings. A selected real device can start capture in subsequent audio frames. An unknown name can be acknowledged but never become active; inspect state and logs.
commands.completion: Immediate settings acknowledgement; device opening/switching happens afterward. This response does not prove device availability.

commands.name: startAudioRecording
commands.summary: Request capture into a temporary PCM WAV recording.
commands.result: Object {path:string|null}. A null path with ok:true means recording did not start, including an already-active session.
commands.effects: May start real input capture, using the configured device or falling back to the first enumerated device when it cannot resolve one. Writes under getPaths.temp/Recordings using existing automatic session naming. Does not take a path or device argument. Device selection is not a sandbox.
commands.completion: Returns once a WAV writer is created, before samples or final header are guaranteed. Use stopAudioRecording and validate the finalized file. Failures are generally logged with a null path; no structured recording status endpoint exists.

commands.name: stopAudioRecording
commands.summary: Stop an active WAV recording and finalize its header.
commands.result: Object {path:string|null}; null when idle, otherwise the finalized recording path.
commands.effects: Closes the active writer; warns if it captured no samples. Capture may remain active for ExternalDevice analysis; recording-only capture teardown is later frame work.
commands.completion: Synchronous file finalization when active. A readable header alone does not prove that samples were captured.
